**`/review` — review this pull request**

Run a formal review of the pull request containing your comment. The review is posted as a comment only; use `/review-approve` to request a formal APPROVE or REQUEST_CHANGES verdict.

**Usage**

```text
/review [approve=<true|false>] [mode=<light|strict>] [model=<codex|claude>] [prompt="<guidance, max 300 characters>"] [reset=<true|false>] [role=<engineer|automation>]
/review help
```

**Options**

| Option | Default | Behavior |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `approve` | — | `true`: request a formal APPROVE or REQUEST_CHANGES verdict, subject to the repository's `.github/autobot/review-config.yml` (`approval.enabled: true`) and your eligible-team membership; otherwise the review is posted as a comment only. Omitted or `false`: the verdict is always capped to a comment. Injected automatically by `/review-approve`; can also be passed as `/review approve=true`. |
| `mode` | Review profile’s default | `light`: high-confidence blocking defects. `strict`: adds edge cases, compatibility, and hardening. |
| `model` | `codex` | Reviewer backend: `codex` or `claude`. |
| `prompt` | — | Optional extra guidance for this run only, added to (never replacing) the repository review skill. Use double quotes, one line, and 1–300 characters. Embedded double quotes and quote escapes are not supported. |
| `reset` | `false` | `false`: follow up on earlier findings and higher-impact introduced regressions. `true`: request a fresh broad review. The selected skill may override reset interpretation, scope, coverage, and funnel filtering. Boolean values are case-insensitive. |
| `role` | `engineer` | Review focus for this dispatch. The repository selects the main review skill; ROLE=engineer or ROLE=automation specializes that skill alongside MODE without selecting or loading a second rubric. |

**Examples**

Default review:

```text
/review
```

Focus this review:

```text
/review prompt="focus on thread safety in the new cache"
```

Fresh, strict review using Claude:

```text

```

**Notes**

- Put the command on one line; option order is unrestricted.
- `/review help` displays help without starting a run.
- The repository selects the main review skill; role and mode specialize its invocation.
- Fallback mode: `light`; `/review mode=` overrides the selected profile's default for this dispatch.
- `role=automation`: Workflow safety, identity and authority, idempotency, retries, and operational behavior.
- `role=engineer`: Implementation correctness, maintainability, tests, and developer-facing behavior.

nodes.body:
<!-- nemo-ci-review-impact:v1 ceiling=moderate -->

Reviewed all five changed files and their directly affected construction, serialization, training, and checkpoint paths. Three delegated inspections are complete. Findings below are based on source inspection; tests were not executed. Suggested code requires author verification.

### [P2] Recognize config-list checkpoints when classifying the saved model family

**Failure:** Build a config-list HybridModel, save a `torch_dist` checkpoint, then reload it using the same Python definition. The builder sets `args.is_hybrid_model=True` while leaving the pattern unset, and [checkpoint saving preserves that namespace](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/ed5ca6a9a2c4204554b7708b3d02ef50a49fdb31/megatron/training/checkpointing.py#L1669-L1674). However, [the load-time classifier](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/ed5ca6a9a2c4204554b7708b3d02ef50a49fdb31/megatron/training/checkpointing.py#L2558-L2581) recognizes only saved pattern fields. It misclassifies this checkpoint as GPT and raises `Loading a GPT checkpoint into a hybrid model requires --hybrid-layer-pattern`. The [same classifier runs for `fsdp_dtensor`](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/ed5ca6a9a2c4204554b7708b3d02ef50a49fdb31/megatron/training/checkpointing.py#L2751-L2756).

**Correction:** In `_maybe_setup_gpt_to_hybrid_load`, after computing `ckpt_pattern`, replace the family-equality check with:

```python
ckpt_is_hybrid = bool(getattr(ckpt_args, "is_hybrid_model", False) or ckpt_pattern)
if runtime_is_hybrid == ckpt_is_hybrid:
    return None, False
```

The saved checkpoint's marker—not the current runtime's marker—must establish its provenance. Retain actual-model runtime detection, the metadata-less early return, legacy pattern recognition, GPT translation validation, and reverse-family rejection.

**Proposed acceptance checks:** A HybridModel shell plus checkpoint args `is_hybrid_model=True, hybrid_layer_pattern=None` must return `(None, False)`; the same checkpoint with a non-Hybrid runtime must raise the reverse-family error. Legacy pattern/override checkpoints must still load normally. Preserve the existing [metadata-less checkpoint assertion](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/ed5ca6a9a2c4204554b7708b3d02ef50a49fdb31/tests/unit_tests/dist_checkpointing/models/test_gpt_hybrid_interop.py#L65-L72), and verify unmarked GPT checkpoints still take compatible pattern translation. Save/reload a small config-list checkpoint and assert weights and resumed iteration are restored.

### [P2] Pass the resolved root configuration into distributed preparation

**Failure:** Use an `AttentionLayerConfig` root with `num_layers=1, bf16=True` and `layers=[root, MTPSplit, root]`. [Core deliberately clones an aliased root](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/ed5ca6a9a2c4204554b7708b3d02ef50a49fdb31/megatron/core/models/hybrid/hybrid_model.py#L195-L204) and infers MTP depth on that clone. The [new assignment retains it](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/ed5ca6a9a2c4204554b7708b3d02ef50a49fdb31/megatron/training/models/hybrid.py#L257-L259), but `build_distributed_models` has already captured the original root. [Distributed preparation receives that stale reference](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/ed5ca6a9a2c4204554b7708b3d02ef50a49fdb31/megatron/training/models/dist_utils.py#L120-L133), so [Float16Module.config](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/ed5ca6a9a2c4204554b7708b3d02ef50a49fdb31/megatron/core/transformer/module.py#L522-L528) still has `mtp_num_layers=None`. Schedules read the outer config and [skip MTP auxiliary-loss scaling](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/ed5ca6a9a2c4204554b7708b3d02ef50a49fdb31/megatron/core/pipeline_parallel/schedules.py#L379-L383), rather than applying the microbatch/loss scale.

**Correction:** Immediately before `unimodal_build_distributed_models` calls `prepare_existing_model_chunks_for_distributed_training`, obtain the constructed model's root:

```python
transformer_config = get_model_config(model_list[0])
```

The helper already imports `get_model_config`. Its pre-wrap hook contract returns the model list, so preparation should follow that list's resolved configuration. Keep caller-owned layer entries unchanged; copying inferred fields back into the original root would violate Core's ownership guarantee.

**Proposed acceptance checks:** Build the root-alias example with `wrap_with_ddp=False` and a recording mixed-precision wrapper. Assert the wrapper receives `model.config`, its MTP depth is 1, and the source root still has `mtp_num_layers is None`. Through loss-scale setup, two microbatches with unit loss scale must publish `0.5`. Retain no-alias and no-MTP cases, the existing [wrapper-call assertions](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/ed5ca6a9a2c4204554b7708b3d02ef50a49fdb31/tests/unit_tests/training/models/test_dist_utils.py#L282-L304) when stages own the supplied root, and the new forwarding test's source-identity/nonmutation assertions.

### [P2] Make default embedding/output ownership virtual-stage-aware

**Failure:** The [newly supported config-list VPP path](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/ed5ca6a9a2c4204554b7708b3d02ef50a49fdb31/megatron/training/models/hybrid.py#L186-L187) permits `build_model(pg, vp_stage=i)` without explicit ownership flags. With PP=2, VPP=2 and four PipelineSplit-delimited segments, [the fallback checks physical rank only](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/ed5ca6a9a2c4204554b7708b3d02ef50a49fdb31/megatron/training/models/hybrid.py#L231-L235). Rank 0's second virtual stage therefore builds an embedding and [uses token embeddings instead of incoming hidden states](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/ed5ca6a9a2c4204554b7708b3d02ef50a49fdb31/megatron/core/models/hybrid/hybrid_model.py#L734-L740); the last physical rank's first virtual stage incorrectly owns output processing. The distributed helper supplies correct explicit flags, but the public single-stage method does not.

**Correction:** Import `is_vp_first_stage` and `is_vp_last_stage` from pipeline utilities and replace the fallback block with the same logic already used by GPTModelBuilder:

```python
vp_size = self._model_config.transformer.virtual_pipeline_model_parallel_size
if pre_process is None:
    pre_process = is_vp_first_stage(
        vp_stage=vp_stage, vp_size=vp_size
    ) and is_pp_first_stage(pg_collection.pp)
if post_process is None:
    post_process = is_vp_last_stage(
        vp_stage=vp_stage, vp_size=vp_size
    ) and is_pp_last_stage(pg_collection.pp)
```

Only the first PP/VP pair may infer embedding ownership, and only the final pair may infer output ownership. Explicit flags must remain authoritative.

**Proposed acceptance checks:** Mock Core construction and check `(pp_rank, vp_stage)` pairs `(0,0)`, `(1,0)`, `(0,1)`, `(1,1)` produce flags `(True,False)`, `(False,False)`, `(False,False)`, `(False,True)`. Preserve explicit overrides, distributed-helper ownership, and existing [non-VPP inference assertions](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/ed5ca6a9a2c4204554b7708b3d02ef50a49fdb31/tests/unit_tests/training/models/test_hybrid_builder.py#L370-L392).

### [P3] Update the migration guide's blanket builder-VPP prohibition

The [migration guide](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/ed5ca6a9a2c4204554b7708b3d02ef50a49fdb31/docs/user-guide/hybrid-model-migration.md#L369-L372) still says declarative HybridModelBuilder rejects VPP and custom-builder users must avoid it. That contradicts this PR's explicit config-list support and directs users away from a supported configuration.

Replace that paragraph with a qualified description, for example:

```text
Declarative HybridModelBuilder config-list architectures support virtual pipeline
parallelism with a preconfigured topology and matching PipelineSplit markers.
The pretrain_hybrid.py CLI path continues to derive virtual stages from pattern segments.
```

Retain the preceding CLI pattern-layout instructions. Static acceptance: the guide must distinguish explicit config-list topology from pattern-derived CLI VPP and no longer prohibit all builder VPP.

> **Note:** formal approval is not available for this request, so this review is posted as a comment only.

*Review generated by codex. This was a full review. Request a full review with `/review reset=true`.*

<!-- nemo-ci-review-rendering:inline-v1 -->
<!-- nemo-ci-formal-review:b747e3fb149776098fbbd3ccc04bf37e9211435150a60c1d35d83a2e985f3983:1496fdb4f38a31ce16a9800b773250c713f99e7fb64c6ccd91322ae1cf7d5842 -->

[P2] Update MoE reporting before routing config-list models into this branch

**Failure:** Build a pattern-free config-list HybridModel containing a MoELayerConfig, with runtime `num_experts` set. This new marker selects [training_log's hybrid branch](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/ed5ca6a9a2c4204554b7708b3d02ef50a49fdb31/megatron/training/training.py#L3950-L4020), but that branch still parses only `args.hybrid_layer_pattern`. Parsing `None` gives empty patterns, so `num_moe_layers=0` and [MoEMetricsTracker.report raises](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/ed5ca6a9a2c4204554b7708b3d02ef50a49fdb31/megatron/core/transformer/moe/moe_logging.py#L185-L194) `MoE metrics require at least one MoE layer`. Training should report the actual MoE contributors instead of failing during reporting.

**Correction:** In `training_log`, derive main-stack MoE positions and MTP-template counts from `cfg.model.hybrid_layer_config_list` when present, using the config-list parser; retain the existing pattern path otherwise. Exclude PipelineSplit markers. Count MTP-template MoE entries once for `mtp_use_repeated_layer`, otherwise once per MTP depth. Keep tracker slot sizing consistent with recorded layers. Hash exclusions apply only to leading main-stack MoE positions, not learned MTP routers. Do not disable the family marker or skip reporting. The exact integration needs author verification; no speculative patch is supplied.

**Proposed acceptance checks, not executed:** A one-MoE list without a pattern must report with `num_moe_layers=1`. One main MoE plus one MoE template at two depths must count 3 contributors without sharing and 2 with sharing. A hash-routed main MoE must be excluded from load-balancing contributors without excluding learned MTP routers. Preserve legacy pattern counts and non-Hybrid `moe_layer_freq` behavior.

[P2] Reconstruct the config sequences now emitted by as_dict

**Failure:** Create a one-layer TransformerConfig, derive an AttentionLayerConfig, and put `[layer]` in HybridModelConfig.hybrid_layer_config_list. After `ModelConfig.from_dict(config.as_dict())`, the entry is a dictionary, not an AttentionLayerConfig: [from_dict reconstructs only directly nested target dictionaries](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/ed5ca6a9a2c4204554b7708b3d02ef50a49fdb31/megatron/training/models/base.py#L209-L220). Core then [rejects the dict entry](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/ed5ca6a9a2c4204554b7708b3d02ef50a49fdb31/megatron/core/models/hybrid/hybrid_layer_allocation.py#L96-L107). This breaks the public [ModelConfig reconstruction contract](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/ed5ca6a9a2c4204554b7708b3d02ef50a49fdb31/megatron/training/models/base.py#L92-L95), independently of checkpoint resume using the original Python definition.

**Correction:** Extend `ModelConfig.from_dict` to decode sequence entries, including dataclass targets and `_call_=False` split markers. Dependent serialization/reconstruction handling is also needed for repeated MTP templates: [Core requires the same source objects across depths](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/ed5ca6a9a2c4204554b7708b3d02ef50a49fdb31/megatron/core/models/hybrid/hybrid_layer_allocation.py#L188-L200), so independently instantiating every emitted dictionary is insufficient. Restore a valid architecture while preserving template sharing; do not intern all equal-valued decoder configs. The identity representation is not determined by the current serializer, so a complete patch needs that decision rather than a blanket recursive-instantiation change.

**Proposed acceptance checks, not executed:** Roundtrip a one-layer list with nondefault `attention_dropout`; assert restored entry type/value and parser acceptance. Cover list/tuple inputs and bare PipelineSplit/MTPSplit restoration. Repeated MTP depths must share their restored template objects, while originally distinct equal-valued decoder configs remain distinct. Preserve source immutability, nested-dataclass/callable reconstruction, and the existing regression that runtime `no_sync_func` is omitted and restores as `None`.

[P2] Account for config-list layers in the newly selected FLOPs path

**Failure:** After building two AttentionLayerConfig entries without a pattern, this predicate is true. However, [num_floating_point_operations](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/ed5ca6a9a2c4204554b7708b3d02ef50a49fdb31/megatron/training/training.py#L1458-L1516) still calls `get_hybrid_layer_counts(args.hybrid_layer_pattern)`. [Parsing None produces zero layer counts](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/ed5ca6a9a2c4204554b7708b3d02ef50a49fdb31/megatron/core/models/hybrid/hybrid_layer_allocation.py#L307-L343), so the result contains only logits compute and omits the decoder. This value is accumulated [every training iteration](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/ed5ca6a9a2c4204554b7708b3d02ef50a49fdb31/megatron/training/training.py#L5486-L5494), corrupting throughput and cumulative-compute accounting.

**Correction:** Add config-list-aware accounting in `num_floating_point_operations`, using each layer's settings and physical MTP repetitions, while retaining legacy pattern accounting. Merely synthesizing a pattern loses heterogeneous expert/FFN widths. The helper currently accepts uniform dimensions, so the exact integration needs author verification rather than a blanket patch. Each constructed decoder/MTP layer must contribute its estimate, with logits counted once per output depth.

**Proposed acceptance checks, not executed:** A uniform two-attention list must equal the existing `"**"` pattern result for both BSHD and explicit THD token statistics—not the logits-only value. Two MoE entries with different expert widths must contribute separate estimates. PipelineSplit markers contribute no compute; each executed MTP depth contributes even with shared weights. Preserve legacy pattern results and the existing [non-Hybrid BSHD/THD assertions](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/ed5ca6a9a2c4204554b7708b3d02ef50a49fdb31/tests/unit_tests/training/test_num_floating_point_operations.py#L132-L147).

The two new attribute-name literals use single quotes, contrary to the repository's explicit [string rule](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/1ac85e91abe858f61f097fca9a27e9d0ec648e4e/style-guide.md#L9-L10), which Black does not enforce. Replace them with `getattr(args, "is_hybrid_model", False)` and `getattr(args, "hybrid_layer_pattern", None)`. This is syntax-only: retain the explicit-marker OR legacy-pattern behavior. Static acceptance is that both added literals use double quotes; no runtime behavior should change.

[P2] Reconstruct the config sequences now emitted by as_dict

**Failure:** Create a one-layer TransformerConfig, derive an AttentionLayerConfig, and put `[layer]` in HybridModelConfig.hybrid_layer_config_list. After `ModelConfig.from_dict(config.as_dict())`, the entry is a dictionary, not an AttentionLayerConfig: [from_dict reconstructs only directly nested target dictionaries](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/ed5ca6a9a2c4204554b7708b3d02ef50a49fdb31/megatron/training/models/base.py#L209-L220). Core then [rejects the dict entry](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/ed5ca6a9a2c4204554b7708b3d02ef50a49fdb31/megatron/core/models/hybrid/hybrid_layer_allocation.py#L96-L107). This breaks the public [ModelConfig reconstruction contract](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/ed5ca6a9a2c4204554b7708b3d02ef50a49fdb31/megatron/training/models/base.py#L92-L95), independently of checkpoint resume using the original Python definition.

**Correction:** Extend `ModelConfig.from_dict` to decode sequence entries, including dataclass targets and `_call_=False` split markers. Dependent serialization/reconstruction handling is also needed for repeated MTP templates: [Core requires the same source objects across depths](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/ed5ca6a9a2c4204554b7708b3d02ef50a49fdb31/megatron/core/models/hybrid/hybrid_layer_allocation.py#L188-L200), so independently instantiating every emitted dictionary is insufficient. Restore a valid architecture while preserving template sharing; do not intern all equal-valued decoder configs. The identity representation is not determined by the current serializer, so a complete patch needs that decision rather than a blanket recursive-instantiation change.

**Proposed acceptance checks, not executed:** Roundtrip a one-layer list with nondefault `attention_dropout`; assert restored entry type/value and parser acceptance. Cover list/tuple inputs and bare PipelineSplit/MTPSplit restoration. Repeated MTP depths must share their restored template objects, while originally distinct equal-valued decoder configs remain distinct. Preserve source immutability, nested-dataclass/callable reconstruction, and the existing regression that runtime `no_sync_func` is omitted and restores as `None`.

Omitted or `false`: the verdict is always capped to a comment. Injected automatically by `/review-approve`; can also be passed as `/review approve=true`. |

<!-- nemo-ci-review-impact:v1 ceiling=moderate -->

Reviewed all five changed files and their directly affected construction, serialization, training, and checkpoint paths. Three delegated inspections are complete. Findings below are based on source inspection; tests were not executed. Suggested code requires author verification.

### [P2] Recognize config-list checkpoints when classifying the saved model family

**Failure:** Build a config-list HybridModel, save a `torch_dist` checkpoint, then reload it using the same Python definition. The builder sets `args.is_hybrid_model=True` while leaving the pattern unset, and [checkpoint saving preserves that namespace](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/ed5ca6a9a2c4204554b7708b3d02ef50a49fdb31/megatron/training/checkpointing.py#L1669-L1674). However, [the load-time classifier](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/ed5ca6a9a2c4204554b7708b3d02ef50a49fdb31/megatron/training/checkpointing.py#L2558-L2581) recognizes only saved pattern fields. It misclassifies this checkpoint as GPT and raises `Loading a GPT checkpoint into a hybrid model requires --hybrid-layer-pattern`. The [same classifier runs for `fsdp_dtensor`](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/ed5ca6a9a2c4204554b7708b3d02ef50a49fdb31/megatron/training/checkpointing.py#L2751-L2756).

**Correction:** In `_maybe_setup_gpt_to_hybrid_load`, after computing `ckpt_pattern`, replace the family-equality check with:

```python
ckpt_is_hybrid = bool(getattr(ckpt_args, "is_hybrid_model", False) or ckpt_pattern)
if runtime_is_hybrid == ckpt_is_hybrid:
    return None, False
```

The saved checkpoint's marker—not the current runtime's marker—must establish its provenance. Retain actual-model runtime detection, the metadata-less early return, legacy pattern recognition, GPT translation validation, and reverse-family rejection.

**Proposed acceptance checks:** A HybridModel shell plus checkpoint args `is_hybrid_model=True, hybrid_layer_pattern=None` must return `(None, False)`; the same checkpoint with a non-Hybrid runtime must raise the reverse-family error. Legacy pattern/override checkpoints must still load normally. Preserve the existing [metadata-less checkpoint assertion](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/ed5ca6a9a2c4204554b7708b3d02ef50a49fdb31/tests/unit_tests/dist_checkpointing/models/test_gpt_hybrid_interop.py#L65-L72), and verify unmarked GPT checkpoints still take compatible pattern translation. Save/reload a small config-list checkpoint and assert weights and resumed iteration are restored.

### [P2] Pass the resolved root configuration into distributed preparation

**Failure:** Use an `AttentionLayerConfig` root with `num_layers=1, bf16=True` and `layers=[root, MTPSplit, root]`. [Core deliberately clones an aliased root](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/ed5ca6a9a2c4204554b7708b3d02ef50a49fdb31/megatron/core/models/hybrid/hybrid_model.py#L195-L204) and infers MTP depth on that clone. The [new assignment retains it](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/ed5ca6a9a2c4204554b7708b3d02ef50a49fdb31/megatron/training/models/hybrid.py#L257-L259), but `build_distributed_models` has already captured the original root. [Distributed preparation receives that stale reference](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/ed5ca6a9a2c4204554b7708b3d02ef50a49fdb31/megatron/training/models/dist_utils.py#L120-L133), so [Float16Module.config](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/ed5ca6a9a2c4204554b7708b3d02ef50a49fdb31/megatron/core/transformer/module.py#L522-L528) still has `mtp_num_layers=None`. Schedules read the outer config and [skip MTP auxiliary-loss scaling](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/ed5ca6a9a2c4204554b7708b3d02ef50a49fdb31/megatron/core/pipeline_parallel/schedules.py#L379-L383), rather than applying the microbatch/loss scale.

**Correction:** Immediately before `unimodal_build_distributed_models` calls `prepare_existing_model_chunks_for_distributed_training`, obtain the constructed model's root:

```python
transformer_config = get_model_config(model_list[0])
```

### [P2] Make default embedding/output ownership virtual-stage-aware

**Failure:** The [newly supported config-list VPP path](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/ed5ca6a9a2c4204554b7708b3d02ef50a49fdb31/megatron/training/models/hybrid.py#L186-L187) permits `build_model(pg, vp_stage=i)` without explicit ownership flags. With PP=2, VPP=2 and four PipelineSplit-delimited segments, [the fallback checks physical rank only](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/ed5ca6a9a2c4204554b7708b3d02ef50a49fdb31/megatron/training/models/hybrid.py#L231-L235). Rank 0's second virtual stage therefore builds an embedding and [uses token embeddings instead of incoming hidden states](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/ed5ca6a9a2c4204554b7708b3d02ef50a49fdb31/megatron/core/models/hybrid/hybrid_model.py#L734-L740); the last physical rank's first virtual stage incorrectly owns output processing. **Correction:** Import `is_vp_first_stage` and `is_vp_last_stage` from pipeline utilities and replace the fallback block with the same logic already used by GPTModelBuilder:

```python
vp_size = self._model_config.transformer.virtual_pipeline_model_parallel_size
if pre_process is None:
    pre_process = is_vp_first_stage(
        vp_stage=vp_stage, vp_size=vp_size
    ) and is_pp_first_stage(pg_collection.pp)
if post_process is None:
    post_process = is_vp_last_stage(

Only the first PP/VP pair may infer embedding ownership, and only the final pair may infer output ownership. Explicit flags must remain authoritative.
